scope: Non-author audit of the combined Moriarty plugin guidance (develop skill + execution-focus reference + README routing) and runtime reader/store/status/testfixture changes. Runtime in scope: typed legacy K observation family (admission/result/consumed), three historical statuses, contained provenance, closed nonnegative compile/krun counters, SQLite close-on-failure, status reporting of stale source and current evidence beside operational history, and a frozen historical sprint fixture. Out of scope: product acceptance, MAIN dispatch authorization, SP05 completion, network/wallet/prover/campaign execution, and any inference from a green test transcript alone.

checks.detail: A well-formed historical K record may sit in the same campaign store as an unrelated current grant. _validate_campaigns only fail-closes the store when the observation is malformed or an unknown campaign field appears. _resolve_campaign_admission still binds the selected campaign id. assess() still requires admitted-* or complete as applicable; the three historical statuses are neither. test_observations_do_not_poison_unrelated_current_admission keeps loan review allowed and leaves campaign/accounting bytes unchanged for all three statuses.

Selecting campaign:historical-k as admissionRef yields authorityCurrent, candidateCurrent and resourceAdmitted false and assess allow false. _status_allows rejects the three historical statuses for implement/repair/admin/review/reproduce/verify. _evidence_applicable also rejects them. Promoting status to complete or admitted-* while K fields remain fail-closes the store (historical-campaign-status-unsupported). consumed is a closed two-counter nonnegative int map and is not read by _verify_resource or remaining-budget math. Extra keys, negatives, bools and floats fail. Unknown field approved still fail-closes. Provenance uses _contained_file (absolute, .., secrets, missing, empty rejected). Contents of admission/result are not treated as binding, candidate, review or credit.

Tests copy plugins/moriarty-dev/tests/fixtures/sp01-financial-contract-and-execution-admission.md (manifest sha256 fdb586d9bf05f2fbf7e9c2294be49854528db20e575faf9aaa1144b033908172, claimed freeze of commit f173efe91f598e1a862d941c1c854692d9219a6b) instead of rewriting live binding or candidate-04 digests. test_live_source_drift_is_not_repaired_by_history_support still fail-closes on unreviewed mutation. Delivered MAIN status/next remain blocked: binding-input-stale and candidate-input-stale on the live sprint document, current-accounting-missing, resource-live-state-unavailable, operational-history; next is report only. Green fixtures do not authorize live work.

Guidance names uncertified I2/MC02, keeps SP01 as an SP05 dependency, and forbids declaring SP05 from a successful-looking loan slice, reused swap, helper-only collector, or missing raw exit. Both fresh full-candidate concurrent audits are required; missing auditors do not substitute. Task routing is Astra author plus Grok 4.6 high and Astra medium for this update only; general Grok plus Opus/Astra is preserved. Receipt ingestion is documented as identity/schema validation, not mechanical roster enforcement. No new scheduler, evidence register, admission exception or CI framework. Report remains allowed; actionful dispatch still uses existing authority, candidate, resource, history, reservation and review gates.

admission, result and consumed were added to the existing closed CAMPAIGN_RECORD_KEYS set. Validation runs only for that named family, requires all three fields, exact counter names, type(value) is int (bool rejected), value >= 0, and one of three statuses. Unknown campaign fields still fail. Not a blanket unknown-field whitelist. Expanding the family still needs explicit semantics.

Historical observations are excluded from _campaign_is_complete, _status_allows implement/review paths, and resource remaining. Policy.py, runner debit/claim, reservation, and review-receipt rules are unchanged. cmd_status only appends non-history missingEvidence to the reason; it does not allow dispatch. Live next allow is report.

init_db closes the integrity-probe connection via contextlib.closing, and closes the opened connection if WAL/schema setup fails. has_other_primary uses closing(). Tests that opened init_db now close it. New StoreConnections tests cover success, missing-file execute failure, failed PRAGMA schema_version, and failed journal_mode. Author transcript: 174 tests OK, no ResourceWarning lines.

When missingEvidence contains non-history gaps, reason names them even if operational history is also unresolved. test_status_cli_names_stale_source_alongside_unknown_history requires both. Delivered runtime-status.json shows history plus binding-input-stale, candidate-input-stale and live accounting gaps. Policy deny codes are not weakened.

Diff adds CampaignHistory (7), StoreConnections (3) and one status stale-source test. 163+11=174 matches the transcript. Existing assertions were not deleted. Remaining edits are connection closing and routing the historical sprint input through the freeze fixture. Fail-closed cases for unknown fields, secret paths, stale hashes, self-review, charge mismatch, primary reservation, and author defect_resolved remain.

One delivery item plus bounded native F0 with existing authority; exact I2/MC02 not full SP05; one reconciliation of existing records then the real caller; retained lineage, counterparty gap and adverse-path handling; independent failure matrix before authoring; sufficient current context with history on disk; both fresh full-candidate audits; six manual metrics in existing records; native verifier route before heavy k17 retry and a bounded discriminator; single K failed-case reproduction then full final conformance; deferred profiles/ACTUS/DeFi/productization/new CI; transaction/resource/approval/history gates preserved; no new framework; readonly inspection needs no new gate; guidance vs CLI enforcement stated honestly in README, SKILL.md and execution-focus.md.

Author transcript of 174 passing tests is supporting evidence only. MAIN remains blocked by stale sprint/source commitments, missing live accounting and unresolved operational history. This verdict does not authorize implementation, credit, settlement or SP05.
